summary: Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature. Changes: monai/data/utils.py (iter_patch yields (patch, coords) pairs with coordinates computed in the unpadded frame; set_rnd skips dunder attributes), monai/data/grid_dataset.py (new PatchIter; GridPatchDataset rebuilt around an injected patch_iter with transform, with_coordinates, worker split via NumPy ceil and NotImplementedError on missing len; PatchDataset docstring uses float), monai/data/__init__.py (exports PatchIter), docs/source/data.rst (PatchIter autodoc after GridPatchDataset), tests/test_grid_dataset.py (TestGridPatchDataset with test_shape and test_loading_array). Nothing was run and nothing was committed. The test expected values come from the spec and are unverified. Choices: setUp and test_loading_array both call set_determinism(seed=1234), per the spec; a TypeError from len() is mapped to NotImplementedError; the class docstring example output was derived by hand.
